rows.caption:
We're in the final days of our Satellite exhibit, "Scotland: My ancestral home", which is on display in the lounge at the Harbourfront Theatre until Sunday, November 1st! Come see this exhibit one last time before it leaves! 

“Scotland: My ancestral home” with oil paintings by Ellen Martin, is based on spiritual experiences Martin had during a recent trip to Scotland and endeavors to capture the magic and mystery she found in the ancient landscape. It's rugged and raw beauty gave her a sense of going back in time.

The exhibition includes large original oil paintings of Moy Castle, Duart Castle, associated with the MacLean clan, and Eilean Donan Castle, among other well-known Scottish landmarks. At Duart Castle, Martin observed swallows swooping and darting about, while sparrows had seemingly taken over Eilean Donan Castle.

Be sure to check out Ellen's book of the same name, available for sale in the Eptek giftshop!

Eptek Art & Culture Centre is open from 10am-4pm Tuesdays-Fridays and 12pm-4pm on Sundays. Admission is by donation. For more information, please contact the Eptek team at 902-888-8373 or at eptek@gov.pe.ca.

The Woofer Willows Dog Park, at 209 Main St., now has lights, making it possible for our furry friends to enjoy the park during these darker fall evenings! ✨
As always, we ask everyone to please respect the posted rules and be courteous to fellow dog owners so that the park remains a safe, fun, and welcoming place for everyone.
Happy walking, playing, and tail-wagging!

Souris PEI in November

stage4.name: BJORN -PD DAY CLINIC
stage4.description: Friday: 10AM-Noon PM U7/U9/U11 rec. Skating and puck skills daily. Jon has worked with thousands of Elite players over the years and understands the minor hockey, private hockey landscape and will help chart the paths of the next generation of ELITE players. Jon connects with the kids, follows their progress and does relevant drills. Practice with a Purpose—covering all aspects of the game, with game-like situations in every session. Jon MacWilliams is an expert at skating, the science behind it, and correction and education on skating mechanics, upper- and lower-body assimilation, edge angles, and skating-related skills. Jon MacWilliams has 35 plus years of skill development experience. Former students include Makar, Crosby, MacKinnon.
